description: Pan-European reference price export (csv, semicolon-delimited, LF, 3 columns): SKU, product name with volume, and EU CLP as the raw EUR list string for the price period, 0% discount. Customers exclude the SKUs in coupa_marketplace_excluded_de.csv.

columns.header: Product Name No Symbols with Volume

columns.expression: (lookup(row['sku'], 'cst_dkfz_bmecat_fields.csv', 'eu_future_list_price' if customer.get('price_period') == 'future' else 'eu_list_price') if discount == 0 else '') or price_for_rounded(row, 'list_price_eur', customer, discount)
